items.name: Pip's Bell-Charm
items.lore: A little brass bell on a string. It rings on its own when water is near.

items.name: River-Stone Ring
items.lore: A smooth black pebble, drilled through and set in copper.

items.name: Reed-Woven Sash
items.lore: Goblin work, oddly fine. It smells of the river.

items.name: Fisherman's Mantle
items.lore: A heavy, patched cloak that once belonged to a man who drowned. Someone has mended it since.

items.name: Menhir-Chip Amulet
items.lore: A flake of the blood-stone, scrubbed clean and blessed three times. It still feels warm.

items.name: Osric's Scrip
items.lore: A friar's simple belt and pouch, full of salt and seeds.

items.name: Sacrificer's Sickle-Pin
items.lore: A bronze cloak pin shaped like the filidh's sickle. Melted down, it would be worth little. Worn, it is a warning.

items.name: Band of Mercy
items.lore: A plain silver ring given to novices of the healers' house.

items.name: Anthill Pebble Ring
items.lore: A pebble the ants polished smooth, set in copper.

items.name: Ludlow Gardener's Sash
items.lore: Green and patched. Ludlow wastes nothing.

items.name: Camlann Mourning Band
items.lore: Black iron. Every family in Ludlow that lost a son at Camlann wears one.

items.name: Sexton's Spade-Pin
items.lore: A little iron spade. The sexton gave you his own.

items.name: Grave-Dust Bracer
items.lore: It never quite comes clean.

items.name: Ferryman's Coin
items.lore: A coin with a hole in it. Huw says it pays your passage, one way or the other.

items.name: Drowned Man's Ring
items.lore: Found in the river. Huw blessed it, then thought better and blessed it again.

items.name: River-Weed Mantle
items.lore: Dried and woven. Smells of the river, faintly, always.

items.name: Marsh-Scale Belt
items.lore: Slith scale, green and gold.

items.name: Reed-Mother's Eye
items.lore: A slith's eye, set in silver. It still blinks, occasionally.

items.name: Landing-Stage Ring
items.lore: Hammered from a robber's iron mooring ring.

items.name: Ferry-Rope Belt
items.lore: Tarred rope. Huw's own.

items.name: Highwayman's Mask-Pin
items.lore: A little silver mask. Very dashing. Very stolen.

items.name: Watch Courier's Bracer
items.lore: Recovered from the ambush. The courier won't need it.

items.name: Ludlow Road Mantle
items.lore: Dusty brown. The road's own colour.

items.name: Spider-Silk Wrap
items.lore: Strong as wire and light as nothing.

items.name: Messenger's Thanks
items.lore: A Watch button. The messenger insisted.

items.name: Nain-Iron Ring
items.lore: Dwarf-work. Too heavy for its size.

items.name: Frund's Beard-Clasp
items.lore: Gold. Frund was very proud of his beard.

items.name: Hearth-Stone Belt
items.lore: Set with a chip of the nain's hearth.

items.name: Red Dwarf Earring
items.lore: Taken from Agisthil's ear. He had several.

items.name: Thief-Catcher's Bracer
items.lore: Ludlow's reward to whoever stopped the thieving.

items.name: Goblin Pick-Head Charm
items.lore: A tiny pick, goblin-forged. Badly.

items.name: Lookout's Spyglass Belt
items.lore: The glass is cracked. The belt is fine.

items.name: Badon Torc
items.lore: Bronze, very old, from the cairn. Morfudd says you'll honour it.

items.name: Red Dragon Brooch
items.lore: Arthur's badge, from Mount Badon.

items.name: Grilk's Toll Ring
items.lore: Grilk charged everyone a toll to enter the mine. Now he doesn't.

items.name: Gobzini's Conjuring Ring
items.lore: It still sparks when you snap your fingers.

items.name: Goblin Lord's Belt
items.lore: Far too big for a goblin. He wore it anyway.

items.name: Watch-Captain's Mantle
items.lore: Watch blue, with a goblin-sized hole in the hem.

items.name: Salizern's Focus
items.lore: A summoner's crystal. Cold, now.

items.name: Humberton Guard's Ring
items.lore: Iron, plain, given to every man on the keep's walls.

items.name: Prior's Psalter-Clasp
items.lore: Brass, worn smooth by the Prior's thumb.

items.name: Cloister Cord
items.lore: A plain white cord - the true brothers' - to replace the red.

items.name: Abbey Gatekeeper's Ring
items.lore: The gatekeeper's ring. He didn't open the gate in time.

items.name: Bell-Rope Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the old bell-rope when it was replaced.

items.name: Tower-Stair Mantle
items.lore: Grey wool, dusty from the bell-tower stair.

items.name: Vetusta Bell Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze bell. It rings true.

items.name: Burhoff's Crozier-Ring
items.lore: Cut from the head of the Bishop's crozier. The red key's been filed off.

items.name: Bell-Ringer of Vetusta's Mantle
items.lore: White wool. Prior Anselm stitched the abbey's bell on it himself.

items.name: Morgana's Seal, Broken
items.lore: Her seal, snapped in two and set on a chain. Wear it as a promise.

items.name: Abbey Smith's Gauntlet-Ring
items.lore: Vetusta's smith made it the day the abbey was retaken.
